Name: Crop Fairy - waters your crops and can grow your crops and trees (even fruit ones)
Author: abslam
Description:
While you sleep there is a chance (that you can fully change) that one or more fairies go into your farm and use their magic to fully grow your crops or to pee in the soil so your crops won't die of dehydration:

[img]https://imgur.com/lGq81s2.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/mdLOTPs.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/didzi95.gif[/img]

[size=4]Installation:[/size]
[size=2]Unzip the folder in Stardew Valley\Mods

[/size][size=4]Configuration:
[/size]You can edit the probability of the crops fully growing or getting watered in the file "config.json".

{
  "PissProbability": 30, // Probability per crop to be watered
  "BlessProbability": 10, // Probability per crop to be fully grown
  "TreeBlessProbability": 2, // Probability per tree to be fully grown [img]https://imgur.com/UhySHJR.png[/img]
  "FruitTreeBlessProbability": 1 // Probability per fruit tree to be fully grown [img]https://imgur.com/UhySHJR.png[/img]
}

If you don't want some option, just set the probability to 0

Downloads.Description: Fixed a bug where fruit trees wouldn't grow properly

Manifest.Name: Crop Fairy
Manifest.Description: While you sleep there is a chance that a fairy touches one or more of your crops so they instantly grow or it can pee to water the soil of a crop.
